name: 15-Minute Previous-Day POC + Value Area Reaction
setup_rules: Open the 15-minute ETH chart and treat each UTC day as one trading session (session open/close).
After a session closes, drag a fixed-range volume profile across that complete previous day.
Mark the three volume-profile levels: POC, value area low, and value area high.
POC is the most important level: it is where the previous day traded the most volume.
Read previous-day direction from that session's open versus close before looking for entries.
entry_rules: Do not enter just because price is at POC. First let price leave POC, then wait for it to come back.
Buy only after price has been clearly above POC, then a 15-minute candle wicks through POC and closes back above (green rejection).
Sell only after price has been clearly below POC, then a 15-minute candle wicks through POC and closes back below (red rejection).
Do not buy above today's open or sell below it — only fade a pullback back to POC.
Skip the trade if today has already expanded more than 100 points; that is a trend day, not a POC fade.
Skip Mondays. Weekend gaps often make yesterday's POC unreliable.
Enter at the close of the reaction candle. Size up to 100 Delta lots (1 lot = 0.01 ETH). One stop-loss still risks 1% of the $10,000 wallet, and notional cannot exceed the wallet (1x).
exit_rules: Take profit at the farther of the opposite value-area bound and 2R / 15 points from the fill.
Stop loss is the reaction candle wick, only if it is 5–10 points from the fill.
If price reaches 1.5R, move the stop to breakeven.
risk_rules: Risk 1% of wallet per trade. On Delta ETHUSD, 1 lot = 0.01 ETH, so a $10,000 account uses about 100 lots — not 6.
Stop trading for the day after a 3% daily loss, or after 3 full stop-losses.
Skip entries where the stop is tighter than 5 points or wider than 10 points.
Require at least 1.5R after the actual fill.
Trade only during 08:00–20:00 UTC. Maximum 4 trades per day.
Do not reuse POC after it has already been traded today.
Load 1 extra previous day so the first test day has a complete volume profile.
